root_keys.name: sequence
root_keys.note: flat ordered list of all 81 IN_MAT_NO (出口材料号) strings; the ordinal position of each material number encodes the production order — the ordered array AS A WHOLE is the agent's answer

fields.name: (array element)
fields.note: IN_MAT_NO string, e.g. 'COIL_052' (coerced via str().strip()); both the value AND its position in the array carry the decision — neither may be altered by the extractor

structural_checks: sequence must be present and a non-empty list (falsy or non-list → fatal error)
every item must be a known IN_MAT_NO from the reference CSV (unknown values → schema error)
sequence must contain exactly 81 items — one per coil in the reference set
